# Crate Map

The `foks-rs` workspace contains twenty-eight library and binary crates plus
the Tauri desktop package. Line counts are rough, from `wc -l` over Rust sources
in September 2026, and are given only to convey relative size.

## Foundations

| Crate | Size | Purpose | Chapters |
|---|---|---|---|
| `foks-snowpack` | 1.9k | Canonical Snowpack codec, byte-compatible with Go v0.1.9 | 9 |
| `foks-proto` | 12.7k | The FOKS v0.1.9 protocol types | 9, 17 |
| `foks-crypto` | 10.0k | Primitives, key suites, hybrid boxes, HESP phrases, KEX | 3–7 |
| `foks-merkle-store` | 1.0k | Storage-neutral Patricia Merkle tree, proofs, epoch history | 11, 12 |
| `foks-verify` | 8.1k | Stateless verification of host, user, and team chains | 10, 13 |
| `foks-rpc` | 8.6k | Snowpack RPC framing, client calls, mutual TLS | 17 |
| `foks-protocol-metadata` | 1.5k | Validation and generation of pinned protocol IDs | 23 |
| `foks-compat-artifact` | 0.6k | Signed hosted-compatibility lease format | 23 |
| `foks-schema-contract` | 3.4k | Streaming equality and hashing of SQLite schema contracts, hosted storage descriptors | 18 |
| `foks-local-deadline` | 0.7k | Same-host monotonic deadline coordinates for local IPC | 19 |

## Dependency order

`foks-snowpack` → `foks-proto` → `foks-crypto` → `foks-verify` →
`foks-client-db` → `foks-client` → `foks-client-app` → `foks-agent`, with
`foks-client` also depending directly on `foks-merkle-store` and `foks-rpc`
(both built on `foks-proto`). `foks-agent-proto` and `foks-agent-client` are
the seam between the agent and its front ends: `foks-mcp` uses only the seam
and the foundation crates, and `foks-desktop` adds `foks-client` for its
device-name rules. `foks-cli` and the Tauri app also link `foks-client-app`,
`foks-keystore` and `foks-yubi` directly (see below). The server chain is
`foks-server` → `foks-server-db` → {`foks-merkle-store`, `foks-crypto`}, and
`foks-server` also uses `foks-rpc` and `foks-verify`. The default
`cargo test` members are the seven core crates: `client-db`, `crypto`,
`proto`, `snowpack`, `verify`, `client`, and `rpc`.

## Layer rules

`tools/crate-layers.toml` assigns every workspace package to a layer and
lists which layers each may depend on through normal and build dependencies.
`scripts/check-crate-layers.py` reads `cargo metadata` and enforces it; the
client and server gates (`tools/foks-client/check.sh`,
`tools/foks-server/check.sh`) and the Linux desktop CI job run it.

| Layer | Crates | May depend on |
|---|---|---|
| core | `snowpack`, `proto`, `crypto`, `verify`, `merkle-store`, `protocol-metadata`, `compat-artifact`, `schema-contract`, `local-deadline` | core |
| network | `rpc`, `oidc` | core |
| device | `keystore`, `yubi` | core |
| agent-protocol | `agent-proto` | core |
| client | `client-db`, `client`, `client-app`, `go-interop` | core, network, device, agent-protocol |
| agent | `agent` | core, network, device, agent-protocol, client |
| agent-client | `agent-client` | core, agent-protocol |
| front-end | `cli`, `mcp`, `desktop`, `desktop-app` | core, agent-protocol, agent-client |
| server | `server-db`, `server`, `metadata-core`, `hosted-transport` | core, network |
| test-support | `server-testkit` (test-only) | all of the above |

Server crates therefore never depend on client, device or agent crates. Front
ends never depend directly on `foks-rpc` or `foks-oidc`; outside the
exceptions below, they reach FOKS servers and identity providers through the
agent. No package reaches `foks-server-testkit` through a production
dependency, directly or transitively. Dev-dependencies are not layer-checked,
but every path dependency must be a workspace package.

Edges that cross these rules are listed as exceptions, each with the source
files that may use the dependency; a use in any other file fails the check.

- `foks-cli` → `foks-client-app`, `foks-keystore`, `foks-yubi`. `foks-rs`
  remains a direct client: `init`, `profile`, `account`, `kv`, `jobs`,
  `device`, `recovery`, `passphrase`, `team` and `yubi` open
  `ClientCredentials` and `ProfileSession` in-process, and `state` calls the
  `foks-client-app` portability functions directly, including
  `verify_imported_profile` for `state verify-online`. The account admin,
  bot, rename and sync commands, team invitations, `mcp`, `sso` and
  `retention` use the agent. The integration tests seed state through
  `foks-client-app` before starting an agent.
- `foks-desktop-app` → `foks-client-app`, `foks-keystore`, `foks-yubi`.
  Offline maintenance with the agent stopped (state export, import,
  relocation, import verification, reset of unreadable state, the state
  leases and readiness checks), described in
  [Chapter 20](20-desktop.qmd), and stateless input validators.
- `foks-desktop` → `foks-client`: `fix_device_name` and `DEVICE_NAME_RULES`.
